proved_scope: Constructive equivalence between full mixed local/remote reachability and initial local closure followed by remote-step/local-closure repetitions.
Read-only query result equivalence under the identical complete state-to-result emitter, preserving ordinary direct results.
Mixed saturation plus seen-state soundness gives exactly full reachable states. Local closure alone is not remote exhaustion.
A separately proved exact emitter output upper bound plus accumulated-key coverage justifies stopping before all search states; a nonempty result is insufficient.
For a fixed compatible-T existential query, first-positive witness is sound and a staged exhaustive negative transfers to the full graph; no all-color/pair enumeration is required.
Negative fixtures for discarding local frontier states before remote expansion and for failing to close local edges after a remote step; explicit shared-visited flag mistake.
The concrete reverse Cg/FLOW→Ch/T→Cf/T→p/T witness needs inherited bridge then local FLOW bridge and local writer.
Both fixed FLOW/T exact output keys can permit coverage stopping; one FLOW key alone does not cover T.
